content.comment_body: Will this HMI connect to the [product_name]? Are there any particular settings required? I haven't ordered the HMI yet but I have [product_name] V15.1 Update 4 and simulation tools, so I just need to confirm if it's compatible before placing the order.

Hello. Yes, [product_name] with [version_no] will connect. You should create a [product_name] project with the HMI and set up the connection to [product_name] in [product_name] where you would typically set up for a PLC. Also, it's important to check if you have the right license for using 'comfort' panels. Do you have the necessary [product_name] license? Out of curiosity, is there a reason for using a comfort panel rather than a basic panel? (The KTP700 Basic panel is my preferred choice for [company_name] projects.) Regards.
Yes, I have the correct license, and my mistake—it is actually the basic panel.
Which settings need to be configured in [product_name]? Is TSAP involved? Thanks.

Hello [user_name]; This [document] could help provide the details you need: How do you establish a connection between a [product_name] [article_no] and an HMI Panel? [url] I hope this helps, [user_name]. For the "Server Connection" item, enter 02.00 for "TSAP".

In [product_name], you only need to make a connection to the [product_name] using the appropriate communication driver. Older examples for [article_no] are not suitable for [article_no]. Would you like an example?

Here is an example setup with [product_name] [version_no] and a KTP700 panel using [product_name] V15.1 (Update 5). You can download Update 5 here: Updates for [product_name] V15.1 and [product_name] V15.1.
